scope: actual USB-only labeled White Panda; volatile SRAM probe, no flash/option writes
observed_usb_failure_before_fix: Windows repeatedly requested device/configuration/BOS descriptors, then FAILED_POST_START
observed_usb_after_fix: Windows enumeration and WSL attachment succeeded; serial/version and 48-byte probe report read successfully
limitations: Not a complete gateway image execution
No physical CAN RX/TX or peer testing
No physical flash programming, power-cut or A/B recovery test
Software register readback is not electrical silence measurement
ROM generic flash descriptor is not physical capacity; actual register reports 1024 KiB
